name: Patriot

abilityDetails.Weakness: Saldırı gücünü düşürür; sıfırın altına inemez.
abilityDetails.Critical into Block: Blok sırasında alınan vuruşlar kritik olabilir.
abilityDetails.Reversal: Uygulayan şampiyondaki Stun etkilerini kaldırır, gelen saldırıyı durdurur ve rakibi yere seren sert bir karşı vuruşla misilleme yapar.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Physical Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen fiziksel hasarı artırır.
abilityDetails.Steadfast: Aktifken, Unblockable saldırılar sanki değillermiş gibi bloklanabilir.

signatureAbility:
To Act Is To Be Committed
Personal Precision Passives gain [10 - 40]% increased potency.
Each Debuff on Patriot grants [144.74 - 485.29] Block Proficiency. Against Science Champions, Patriot's Block Proficiency cannot be reduced below where this ability would set it, and the Opponent's Block Penetration is locked to 0.

abilitySections.title: Get Back Up Again - Always Active
content: Incoming Weakness effects and the potency of the Opponent's Inequity Mastery suffer 76% reduced potency.
For each Debuff on Patriot, he gains +[1,144] Attack Rating. Max Benefit at 7 Debuffs.
Patriot gains an indefinite Steadfast Passive while suffering from at least 5 non-Damaging Debuffs. Against Science Champions, this threshold is reduced to 3 non-Damaging Debuffs.
Patriot's Base Regeneration Rate is 44% and cannot be lowered further.
While a Science Opponent has a Fury Passive active and Patriot is Blocking, he inflicts a 40% Weakness Passive. This Weakness gains up to 100% increased potency based on Patriot's missing health.

abilitySections.title: Prodigious Tactician
content: Patriot gains an additional hit in his Combo Meter when striking the Opponent or their Block with a Light Attack or when Blocking an attack.
As a Defender, Patriot starts each fight with an indefinite Combo Shield Passive.
When either Champion Well-Timed Blocks, Patriot gains a Vigilance Passive for 3 seconds.
If a personal Precision is not active, knocking down the Opponent grants Patriot a +[1,833.33] Precision Passive for 5 seconds.
Personal Precision effects allow Patriot to land Critical Hits into Block and pause for 0.5 seconds when the Opponent or their Block is struck.

abilitySections.title: Heroic Resolve - Debuffs
content: Resolve Debuffs are indefinite and have no effect. Max stacks: 10.
When the Combo Meter rises past a multiple of 10, Patriot gains one Resolve Debuff and increases his Critical Damage Rating by +[44.72] for the rest of the fight.
Whenever a non-Damaging Debuff on Patriot other than Resolve ends for any reason, gain one Resolve Debuff.
When Patriot is struck by the final hit of a Special Attack, he loses one Resolve, or two against Mutants.

abilitySections.title: Sudden Reversal - While at 7+ Resolve Debuffs
content: As a Defender, when Patriot would be struck by a Basic Attack, he consumes 7 Resolve to execute a Reversal.
When Reversing, gain a non-stacking Fury Passive, increasing Attack Rating by +[13,200] for 12 seconds.

As an Attacker, if Patriot would be struck by a Basic Attack while charging a Heavy Attack, he consumes 7 Resolve to execute a Reversal and gain two personal Precision Passives, and his Fury gains 87% increased duration.
Patriot's Heavy can be charged for an extended duration.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each of the four hits grant +3 additional Combo Meter.
For each multiple of 10 the Combo Meter passed during this attack, the final hit inflicts one [916.67] Physical Vulnerability Debuff for 30 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: If this attack is activated while the Opponent is standing up after a Reversal, it is Passively Unblockable, and personal Fury and Precision Passives are paused during the Special and for 8 seconds after.
Projectile hits inflict [6,160] Rupture Debuffs for 6.5 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: The first three times this attack is used, Patriot reduces the number of Resolve Debuffs consumed by his Reversal by 1 for the rest of the fight.
Refresh personal Fury and Precision Passives.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - To Act Is To Be Committed
content: Personal Precision Passives gain [10 - 40]% increased potency.

Each Debuff on Patriot grants [144.74 - 485.29] Block Proficiency. Against Science Champions, Patriot's Block Proficiency cannot be reduced below where this ability would set it, and the Opponent's Block Penetration is locked to 0.
